en: Black‑and‑white view of a largely empty town square bordered by 2–3‑storey plastered buildings with steep gabled roofs. On the left are commercial houses with signage at street level; in the distance a baroque church tower with an onion dome rises above the roofs. At the right stands a large leafy tree near additional houses and small shops. The image has the look of an early 20th‑century photograph printed as a postcard.
